text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited at all times on the west side of Stephen Drive from a point 62 metres south of the north limit of Stephen Drive and a point 23 metres further south.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Stephen Drive from a point 62 metres south of the north limit of Stephen Drive and a point 23 metres further south.
